$comment: Severity mapping. severity_number uses OTel base values. Map Python WARNING->WARN, CRITICAL->FATAL, Nest verbose->TRACE (deliberate).

rules.retries: A retry is usually WARN; exhausted/terminal failure is ERROR.
rules.fatal: FATAL means the process cannot continue.
rules.terminal_outcome: Emit one terminal outcome per operation/attempt owner; a returned failure envelope, MCP isError result, fallback, expired deadline, or abnormal stream end is not success.
